g.text: From open evening to first practice
Newcomers at our open evenings find a clear, no-pressure next step into a first practice session, so interest
You work through one small loop, as often as you like:
: what would count as better, how you will measure it, and what must
: one small change you can make yourself, with a forecast written
: the concrete next thing you will do.
: what actually happened. Doing the work is not the same as it
: compare the result with the original forecast, then keep, adjust
Everything is saved in the case folder as you go. Closing the app keeps your
view (Ctrl+T) draws the six thinking-process trees, one at a time:
Goal, Current Reality, Evaporating Cloud, Future Reality, Prerequisite and
Transition. Ctrl+N moves to the next tree, and after the sixth shows all six
Enter adds a line · Send asks the offline guide
